plugins.name: fable-advisor
plugins.description: Read-only Fable advisor subagent for decisions, plan reviews, stalled debugging and change-set verification — tracks the newest Fable release via the fable alias (Fable 5.1 today), with Opus fallback when Fable is unavailable. Enforcement hooks inject the advisor policy every session, gate ExitPlanMode on a consultation, hold unadvised multi-file turns for review, and enforce consultation inside background worker subagents.

plugins.name: advisor-select
plugins.description: Pick which model advises the current session — e.g. main conversation on Sonnet, second opinions from Opus. Session-scoped selection with fallback and substitution detection.

plugins.name: pause-resume
plugins.description: Freeze a running agent between tool calls and thaw it later with full context intact — for moving locations, losing connectivity, or sleeping the laptop mid-task. Auto-resumes when the network returns, and rebuilds resume briefs from the transcript when a session is cut off.

plugins.name: feature-crew
plugins.description: Turn one session into an orchestrator: features and revisions you ask for are built by background feature-builder subagents, each on its own crew/* branch in an isolated worktree, while the conversation stays free. The main session keeps a roster, relays workers' questions, resumes them with your answers, and reports when each is done.
